title: Minted Pineapple
blurb: Fresh pineapple slices tossed with sugar and mint, left to macerate briefly before serving.
steps: Cut the top and bottom off the pineapple, then slice away the skin in downward strips. Cut the pineapple into quarters lengthways and remove the tough core from each quarter.
Slice the pineapple flesh thinly across into pieces about 3mm thick and place in a large bowl.
Pick the mint leaves from their stems and chop them finely.
Scatter the sugar and chopped mint over the pineapple, then toss everything together with your hands or a spoon.
Leave the mixture to sit for 10 minutes so the sugar starts to dissolve and the juices begin to run.
Transfer to a serving dish or individual bowls and serve.
